contentGovernance.livePolicyStatus: No live-rule assertions are made; cases that require current policy or server state are sent to private support.

commonFallback.heading: Still not fixed?
commonFallback.body: If none of the fixes above worked, create one private Discord ticket for this problem.
commonFallback.existingTicket: Already have a ticket for this problem? Add the new details there instead of opening another one.
commonFallback.safety: Never share your password, seed phrase, private key, sign-in code, or full card number. CoC support will not ask you to transfer assets.

issues.title: I paid, but my purchase is missing
issues.problem: The payment appears to have completed, but the item or currency is not in your account.
whatMayBeHappening: The payment may still be pending or may have failed.
The purchase may be attached to a different CoC account or connected wallet.
Payment can succeed before the game inventory updates.
issues.caution: Do not buy the item again while the first payment status is unclear.

fixes.title: Check the payment status
fixes.action: Open the wallet, card receipt, or payment provider used for the purchase and find the transaction.
fixes.expected: You should see Pending, Successful, Failed, or Cancelled.
fixes.next: If it is pending, wait for the provider to update it. If it failed or was cancelled, do not expect delivery. Continue only if it is successful or you cannot find a clear status.

fixes.title: Check the account and wallet
fixes.action: Return to CoC using the same sign-in method and, for a wallet payment, confirm that the paying wallet appears in Connected Accounts.
fixes.expected: You should be viewing the same account that made the purchase.
fixes.next: If a different account opened, stop here and use the account-access guide. If the account is correct, continue.

fixes.title: Refresh the inventory once
fixes.action: Close and reopen the relevant inventory or Shop view once. Check whether the item was already used after purchase.
fixes.expected: The purchased item or balance should appear on the correct account.
fixes.next: If the successful purchase is still missing, open Discord support with the item, quantity, approximate time, payment method, and transaction or order ID.

issues.title: Nightmare did not start
issues.problem: You entered a Nightmare room, but the Nightmare session or Virus never started.
whatMayBeHappening: The room may not have entered the Nightmare state correctly.
A connection or room-lifecycle problem may have interrupted the start.
This is different from a general room-entry error such as CODE(0).
issues.caution: Do not use another Nightmare Key to test the room.

fixes.title: Check whether the key was used
fixes.action: Open your inventory and compare the current Nightmare Key count with the count before entry, if known.
fixes.expected: You should be able to tell whether a key was removed, was not removed, or is unknown.
fixes.next: If no key was removed, leave the room and use the room-entry guide if you still cannot play. If a key was removed or you are unsure, continue.

fixes.title: Check the room state
fixes.action: Note whether Virus appeared and whether any AP was earned in that room. Do not refresh while a valuable live session may still be active.
fixes.expected: This separates a no-start session from a session that started and later disconnected.
fixes.next: If the session started and later stopped, use the disconnect guide. If it never started, continue.

fixes.title: Wait and note what happened
fixes.action: Do not use another Key. Note the room name, exact entry time and timezone, Key status, Virus status, and any AP received.
fixes.expected: You should have a clear record of the failed attempt without risking another Key.
fixes.next: If the session never became playable, open Discord support now with these details. Do not spend another Key to reproduce it.

issues.title: The game will not load
issues.problem: The game stops before sign-in, after sign-in, or on a loading screen.
whatMayBeHappening: The game or Base App may need an update.
The current browser, app session, or network may be stuck.
A problem that follows the same account across environments may need account or server review.
issues.caution: Use the same sign-in method as your existing account. Do not create a new account or clear sign-in data unless you can recover access.

fixes.title: Reopen the game safely
fixes.action: When you are not in an active match, close the game tab or Base App view and open it again.
fixes.expected: A temporary loading session should clear and the sign-in or game screen should appear.
fixes.next: If it still stops at the same place, continue.

fixes.title: Check for an update
fixes.action: Update the Base App or reload the current web version, then sign in with the same method as before.
fixes.expected: The latest client should pass the point where the older session stopped.
fixes.next: If the same error remains, continue.

fixes.title: Compare one other environment
fixes.action: Try Web instead of Base App, or Base App instead of Web. If practical, compare one other network without using a new account.
fixes.expected: If one environment works, keep using it and avoid clearing the working session.
fixes.next: If the same account fails everywhere, open Discord support with the stopping point, exact error, device, OS, platform, and time.

issues.title: My Dust balance looks wrong
issues.problem: Inventory and Craft & Upgrade show different Dust balances, or the balance changed after an upgrade or dismantle.
whatMayBeHappening: One screen may be showing an older balance.
Dust may have been spent by an upgrade.
A completed action may not have synchronized with the displayed balance yet.
issues.caution: If an upgrade, claim, or dismantle is still pending, do not repeat it.

fixes.title: Compare both Dust balances
fixes.action: On the same CoC account, note the Dust shown in Inventory and in Craft & Upgrade.
fixes.expected: The two screens should show the same available balance.
fixes.next: If they match, compare the balance with the cost of your latest or planned upgrade. If they differ, continue.

fixes.title: Reopen the affected view once
fixes.action: Sign out and back in, or close and reopen the affected view once when no action is pending.
fixes.expected: A stale display may update to the current server balance.
fixes.next: If both values now match, use the updated value. If they still differ, continue.

fixes.title: Recheck the last action
fixes.action: Check the Dust cost and result of the latest upgrade or dismantle instead of estimating from the number of NFTs in inventory.
fixes.expected: The displayed change should match a completed action and its shown cost or reward.
fixes.next: If the arithmetic still does not match, open Discord support with both balances, the action, NFT, shown cost or reward, and exact time.

issues.title: The wrong wallet is connected
issues.problem: The wallet connected to an action is different from the Main Wallet selected for your CoC account.
whatMayBeHappening: Your browser or Base App may have connected another linked wallet.
The wallet currently active in your wallet app may not be your selected Main Wallet.
Uppercase and lowercase letters do not make two otherwise identical addresses different.
issues.caution: Never share a seed phrase, private key, password, or sign-in code.

fixes.title: Check your selected Main Wallet
fixes.action: Open Treasury and find the wallet selected as Main Wallet for this CoC account.
fixes.expected: Treasury may show the address currently presented as Main Wallet for this account; this display alone does not confirm backend identity.
fixes.next: If the address is missing, ambiguous, or unavailable to you, stop without changing Main Wallet and open private support. Otherwise continue.
fixes.ambiguityNote: A displayed address match does not confirm backend Main Wallet identity. If the state is missing, shows a fallback, or is ambiguous, treat the result as unknown.

fixes.title: Compare the connected address
fixes.action: Compare the full address connected to the current action with the Main Wallet address from Treasury.
fixes.expected: The addresses should match, ignoring letter case.
fixes.next: If they already match, the displayed addresses agree but a backend discrepancy is still possible. Use the guide for the failed action and include address details. If they differ, continue.
fixes.ambiguityNote: A displayed address match does not confirm backend Main Wallet identity. If the state is missing, shows a fallback, or is ambiguous, treat the result as unknown.

fixes.title: Connect the selected Main Wallet
fixes.action: Only when Treasury shows an unambiguous address that you control, disconnect the current action, connect that same wallet, and return without submitting the action.
fixes.expected: The action may then display the same address shown in Treasury; this still does not prove backend identity.
fixes.next: If any address is missing, different, or ambiguous, stop without linking, unlinking, or transacting and open private support.
fixes.ambiguityNote: A displayed address match does not confirm backend Main Wallet identity. If the state is missing, shows a fallback, or is ambiguous, treat the result as unknown.

issues.title: I think my wallet is compromised
issues.problem: You saw an unexpected transaction, signature request, suspicious link, or lost access to a wallet used with CoC.
whatMayBeHappening: A third party may be trying to obtain access or approval.
A transaction or signature may have been approved outside CoC.
Only a private review can determine what account-recovery options are currently available.
issues.caution: Do not sign, approve, or transfer anything requested by an unsolicited message. CoC support will never ask for your secret recovery data.

fixes.title: Stop new approvals
fixes.action: Close suspicious pages and reject any signature or transaction you do not understand.
fixes.expected: No new approval should be created from that page or prompt.
fixes.next: Do not return to the suspicious link. Continue.

fixes.title: Use only official support
fixes.action: Ignore unsolicited DMs. Open your wallet provider through its official app or website to review approvals and permissions, and use only the private support link shown after these steps.
fixes.expected: You should use the wallet provider's official security tools and CoC's official private ticket route, never a direct-message conversation.
fixes.next: Create a private ticket with public wallet and transaction information only; never include credentials or recovery data.

discordDetails: Whether you still control the wallet

governance.note: Requires outcome-specific safe terminals per Head of Support P0-2

outcomeTerminals.label: I rejected the suspicious prompt and see no unexpected approvals or transactions
outcomeTerminals.guidance: Good. The rejection itself does not guarantee prior safety, but no visible unauthorized activity is a positive sign. Review your wallet provider's approval/permissions list and revoke any you do not recognize. Enable transaction notifications if available.

outcomeTerminals.label: I see an approval or transaction I did not authorize
outcomeTerminals.guidance: Do not interact with the suspicious approval or transaction. Use your wallet provider's official security tools to revoke unknown approvals. Then create a private Discord ticket so CoC support can review your game account for related activity.

outcomeTerminals.label: I have lost access to my wallet entirely
outcomeTerminals.guidance: CoC cannot recover a wallet or its contents. Create a private Discord ticket now so CoC support can review and protect your game identity and linked-account state. Separately, use only your wallet provider's official recovery process for wallet access.

outcomeTerminals.label: I am not sure what happened
outcomeTerminals.guidance: Do not sign, approve, or transfer anything until the situation is clear. Create a private Discord ticket describing what you observed. CoC support can review your account activity without needing your wallet credentials.

issues.title: I cannot join a room
issues.problem: The game loads, but room entry fails, reconnects repeatedly, or shows an error such as CODE(0), 4001, or 1006.
whatMayBeHappening: The problem may affect one room, one platform, or the current account session.
The same error code can appear in different contexts and does not prove one root cause.
A failure that follows the account across environments may require server-side review.
issues.caution: Do not spend a paid item or Nightmare Key to test room access.

fixes.title: Try another free room
fixes.action: Try one other room that does not require a paid item and note whether the error is identical.
fixes.expected: You should learn whether the problem affects one room or all rooms.
fixes.next: If only one room fails, avoid it and note any in-game notices. If all rooms fail, continue.

fixes.title: Reopen outside a match
fixes.action: Close and reopen the game when no valuable session is active, then use the same sign-in method.
fixes.expected: A temporary room session may clear.
fixes.next: If room entry still fails, continue.

fixes.title: Compare one other environment
fixes.action: Try Web instead of Base App, or one other network, while keeping the same CoC account.
fixes.expected: If one environment works, that suggests the original environment or session may be involved; it does not prove a single cause.
fixes.next: If the same error appears across environments, open Discord support with the room, exact code, time, platform, device, and checks tried.

issues.title: The game lags or disconnects during play
issues.problem: Gameplay becomes slow, freezes, reloads, or disconnects after a room has started.
whatMayBeHappening: The current network or client may be unstable.
Base App and Web can behave differently on the same device.
Lost AP or items cannot be confirmed from the screen alone and may need session review.
issues.caution: Do not refresh a valuable live session only to test it or create evidence.

fixes.title: Protect the active session
fixes.action: If the room is still active, stop extra clicks and wait briefly for the connection to recover before closing anything.
fixes.expected: A short interruption may reconnect without ending the session.
fixes.next: If the room does not recover, note the last playable time before reopening.

fixes.title: Reopen on the same account
fixes.action: After the session has stopped responding, reopen the game with the same sign-in method. If possible, use Web when Base App is unstable.
fixes.expected: You may reconnect to the same account or confirm that the session has ended.
fixes.next: If normal play returns and no progress is missing, continue playing. If the problem repeats, continue.

fixes.title: Compare the connection before the next session
fixes.action: Before using another valuable item, try a free room on another stable network or platform.
fixes.expected: A stable free-room test should show whether the original environment is still unreliable.
fixes.next: If disconnects continue, or AP/items appear lost, open Discord support with the room, time, last playable moment, platform, network, AP, and items used.

discordDetails: Start and last playable time with timezone
Keys, boosters, or Virus Threat used

issues.title: A Nightmare Key is missing
issues.problem: Your Nightmare Key count is lower than expected after a session, reset, claim, reconnect, or maintenance.
whatMayBeHappening: A key may have been used when the session started.
The displayed count may have changed after a weekly rule or reset.
A duplicate debit or failed session needs server-side review.
issues.caution: Do not use another Nightmare Key as a test. Current key rules can change, so old caps or event rules may no longer apply.

fixes.title: Record where the count changed
fixes.action: Note the last known count, the current count, and whether the change followed a session, reset, claim, reconnect, or maintenance.
fixes.expected: You should have a time and event boundary for a server-side inventory review without relying on an old rule.
fixes.next: If the reason is still unclear, continue without spending another Key.

fixes.title: Check the affected session
fixes.action: Identify the room and exact time when the count changed, and note whether the session started and earned AP.
fixes.expected: You should be able to distinguish normal key use from a no-start, duplicate-debit, or disconnect case.
fixes.next: If the session never started, use the Nightmare-start guide. Otherwise continue.

fixes.title: Recheck inventory once
fixes.action: After any announced maintenance or automatic return has completed, reopen inventory once.
fixes.expected: Any completed automatic return should appear in the current count.
fixes.next: If the key is still missing, open Discord support with the exact time, room, count before and after, AP earned, and items used.

issues.title: My AP looks wrong
issues.problem: Activity Points shown during play, in the results, or on the leaderboard do not match what you expected.
whatMayBeHappening: One screen may be showing an older or temporary value.
A partial session, team state, booster, or current event rule may change the result.
Leaderboard updates and personal AP updates can happen separately.
issues.caution: Your expected AP is useful evidence, but it does not by itself confirm an owed balance.

fixes.title: Find where the value differs
fixes.action: Compare the AP shown during the match, on the results screen, and on your profile or leaderboard.
fixes.expected: You should see whether one screen or every screen has the same discrepancy.
fixes.next: If only the leaderboard is stale, use the leaderboard guide. Otherwise continue.

fixes.title: Reopen the display once
fixes.action: When the session is over, reopen the affected screen once without starting another paid session.
fixes.expected: A display-only value may update to the recorded result.
fixes.next: If the corrected value appears, no further action is needed. If not, continue.

fixes.title: Check the session context
fixes.action: Record the observed AP, room, session length, party state, and any AP Booster or event label shown in the client.
fixes.expected: The report should identify the exact value and session context without assuming a current multiplier or policy.
fixes.next: If it still looks wrong, open Discord support with observed and expected AP, room, exact time, session length, teammates, and boosters.

splitInfo.note: First identify where the value diverges before proceeding

issues.title: Craft, claim, upgrade, or dismantle failed
issues.problem: A Craft & Upgrade action did not complete, stayed pending, lost its button, or completed without the expected result.
whatMayBeHappening: The wallet request may still be pending or may have failed.
The connected wallet may not be the selected Main Wallet.
The transaction may have succeeded before the item or balance synchronized.
issues.caution: Do not repeat a pending or unknown onchain action. Never dismantle another NFT to test a failure.

fixes.title: Separate an irreversible wrong-item result first
fixes.action: If the wrong NFT was dismantled or another irreversible result occurred, stop all Craft actions immediately and record the NFT/token ID, action, time, and receipt. Otherwise open wallet activity and look for the action receipt or transaction hash.
fixes.expected: You should see Pending, Successful, Failed, or no transaction.
fixes.next: For a wrong-item or other irreversible result, do not link, unlink, reconnect, or submit another action; continue only to the support handoff. If pending, stop and wait. If failed, keep the error. Otherwise continue.

fixes.title: Check the Main Wallet
fixes.action: Open Treasury and confirm that the wallet used for the action matches the selected Main Wallet.
fixes.expected: The displayed addresses may agree, but this does not confirm backend Main Wallet identity.
fixes.next: If they differ or either display is missing or ambiguous, stop without changing wallets and use the Main Wallet guide. If they visibly agree, continue without repeating a successful transaction.

fixes.title: Check the result once
fixes.action: For a successful transaction, reopen Inventory and Craft & Upgrade once and look for the item or updated balance.
fixes.expected: A completed result should appear without another transaction.
fixes.next: If the result is missing, the claim button vanished, or the wrong NFT was dismantled, open Discord support immediately with the action, NFT, count, time, and receipt.

splitInfo.note: Different actions have different risk levels and recovery paths

issues.title: My NFT is not showing
issues.problem: An NFT you bought, crafted, or claimed is visible onchain or in a marketplace but not in CoC, or the reverse.
whatMayBeHappening: The purchase or mint may still be pending.
The wallet that owns the NFT may not be connected to this CoC account.
Onchain ownership, game inventory, and marketplace metadata can update separately.
issues.caution: Never transfer an NFT to support or connect to a recovery link sent by DM.

fixes.title: Verify the onchain status
fixes.action: Open the transaction or token in a read-only chain explorer and confirm that the transaction succeeded and which wallet owns the NFT.
fixes.expected: The explorer should show a successful transaction and the current owner.
fixes.next: If the transaction is pending or failed, wait for or follow that status. If ownership is confirmed, continue.

fixes.title: Check Connected Accounts
fixes.action: Confirm that the owner wallet appears in Connected Accounts on the CoC account you are viewing.
fixes.expected: The owning wallet and the current CoC account should be linked.
fixes.next: If a different or empty account opened, use the account-access guide. If the wallet is present, continue.

fixes.title: Reopen inventory once
fixes.action: After the transaction has settled, sign back into the same account and reopen inventory once.
fixes.expected: The item may appear after the game inventory refreshes.
fixes.next: If ownership is confirmed but the NFT is still missing or its metadata is wrong, open Discord support with the collection, token ID, wallet, marketplace, and transaction hash.

discordDetails: Where the NFT is and is not visible

issues.title: Ads or Watch & Spin are not working
issues.problem: No ad is available, the ad will not load, playback fails, or the ad finishes without a reward.
whatMayBeHappening: Ad availability can differ by region, time, device, or provider.
A VPN, content blocker, or failed provider session may prevent playback.
A completed ad and a missing reward are separate problems.
issues.caution: Do not repeatedly watch ads, switch through VPN regions, or press Retry in a loop to force a reward.

fixes.title: Separate availability from a missing reward
fixes.action: If an ad already completed without a reward, do not watch another one; reopen the relevant reward or inventory view once. If no ad started, note whether it was unavailable, failed to load, or crashed.
fixes.expected: You should identify a delivery problem separately from ad availability or playback.
fixes.next: If a completed reward is still missing, keep the completion time and continue to support handoff without replaying. For availability or playback, continue.

fixes.title: Remove local blockers for playback only
fixes.action: Only if the ad did not complete, turn off any VPN or content blocker for CoC and reopen Watch & Spin once.
fixes.expected: A local availability or playback blocker may clear; this step is not a remedy for an already missing reward.
fixes.next: If the ad remains unavailable or playback fails, continue. Do not replay an ad that already completed without a reward.

fixes.title: Compare one other platform only for availability
fixes.action: If no ad completed, try Web instead of Base App, or Base App instead of Web, once at a later time. Do not use this as a reward-delivery retry.
fixes.expected: A platform-specific availability problem may differ; no result here proves reward eligibility.
fixes.next: If availability or playback still fails, or a completed reward is missing, open Discord support with the exact symptom, time, device, platform, region, and any visible reference.

discordDetails: No ad, playback failure, or missing reward

splitInfo.note: Ad availability and reward delivery are separate failure points

issues.title: My wallet is already linked, or a new empty account opened
issues.problem: Sign-in opened the wrong CoC account, or CoC says the wallet is already linked elsewhere.
whatMayBeHappening: You may have used a different sign-in method from the one used for the original account.
The wallet may already belong to another CoC account.
A new Base wallet sign-in can look like a new empty game account.
issues.caution: Do not progress the empty account, create more accounts, or unlink wallets as a first step.

fixes.title: Return to the original sign-in method
fixes.action: Sign out of the empty or wrong account, then use the same email, Google, Discord, or other method used for the original CoC account.
fixes.expected: Your original nickname, progress, and Connected Accounts should return.
fixes.next: If the original account opens, check its connected wallets. If it does not, continue.

fixes.title: Check accounts you can still access
fixes.action: Without unlinking anything, note the nickname and public wallet addresses shown by each accessible account.
fixes.expected: This should reveal whether the wallet is attached to an existing account you recognize.
fixes.next: If you find the original account, keep using it. If ownership is unclear or access is lost, continue.

fixes.title: Stop account changes
fixes.action: Do not link, unlink, or transfer assets while the account relationship is unclear.
fixes.expected: The current account state remains available for private review.
fixes.next: Open Discord support with the original nickname, sign-in methods tried, public wallet addresses, and what account each method opens.

splitInfo.note: Each identity problem has a different safe resolution

issues.title: The leaderboard has not updated
issues.problem: Your displayed rank or leaderboard AP does not match your current personal AP.
whatMayBeHappening: The leaderboard may update separately from personal AP.
The page may still show an older rank or value.
A personal AP problem and a leaderboard refresh problem need different checks.
issues.caution: Refreshing the leaderboard does not prove that server AP was lost.

fixes.title: Compare personal AP and leaderboard AP
fixes.action: Note the AP on your profile and the AP and rank shown on the leaderboard at the same time.
fixes.expected: You should see whether only rank, only AP, or both are out of date.
fixes.next: If personal AP is wrong too, use the AP guide. If only the leaderboard differs, continue.

fixes.title: Refresh once
fixes.action: Keep the old values and time, then refresh the leaderboard once.
fixes.expected: A stale leaderboard view may update to the newer values.
fixes.next: If it updates, no further action is needed. If it does not, continue.

fixes.title: Record the update boundary
fixes.action: Note the last known correct rank and AP, the current personal and leaderboard values, and the exact time shown on both screens.
fixes.expected: The report should separate a stale leaderboard display from a personal AP discrepancy without assuming an update schedule.
fixes.next: If the values still differ, open Discord support with personal AP, leaderboard AP, rank, last known correct value, and timestamped screenshots.

issues.title: My referral progress was not counted
issues.problem: A referral did not appear, did not meet eligibility, did not generate expected progress, or did not produce an expected payout.
whatMayBeHappening: The invite may not have linked during sign-in.
The referred account or activity may not meet the current eligibility rules.
Purchase attribution and referral payout are separate stages, and some payment methods may not qualify.
issues.caution: This guide cannot promise retroactive referral credit.

fixes.title: Identify the missing stage
fixes.action: Check whether the problem is the invite opening, account linkage, eligibility progress, purchase attribution, or payout.
fixes.expected: You should have one specific stage to verify instead of a general referral complaint.
fixes.next: If the invite never linked, the referred player should use their own account when contacting support. Otherwise continue.

fixes.title: Record what the referral flow showed
fixes.action: Note the invite link or entry path, both nicknames, the displayed referral stage, activity or purchase time, and payment method when relevant.
fixes.expected: The report should identify the missing stage without deciding eligibility from an unpublished or outdated rule.
fixes.next: Continue to recheck the displayed progress once; private support must confirm any current eligibility or payout decision.

fixes.title: Reopen referral progress once
fixes.action: Refresh the referral view once and compare it with the affected account or purchase time.
fixes.expected: A delayed display may show the linked referral or progress.
fixes.next: If it is still missing, open Discord support with the failed stage, both nicknames, approximate time, and payment method or receipt when relevant.

discordDetails: Payment method and receipt if relevant

issues.title: Glider verification or reward is stuck
issues.problem: Glider is stuck at enrollment, first verification, the waiting period, second verification, claim, or unstake.
whatMayBeHappening: Each Glider stage has a separate review or waiting state.
A displayed waiting period can be expected behavior rather than a failed verification.
The portfolio balance may not have been read correctly, or the claim or unstake step may have failed.
issues.caution: Do not resubmit repeatedly or assume that a waiting state means the flow is broken.

fixes.title: Find the exact Glider stage
fixes.action: Open Glider and note whether it shows enrollment, first verification, waiting, second verification, claim, or unstake.
fixes.expected: The displayed stage should determine the next check.
fixes.next: If it shows a waiting period, follow the exact window displayed by Glider. Otherwise continue.

fixes.title: Check the portfolio details
fixes.action: Open the submitted Glider portfolio URL and confirm it is the intended portfolio and still shows the required OWB balance as displayed by the Glider interface.
fixes.expected: The portfolio URL and visible balance should match what was submitted.
fixes.next: If the URL or portfolio is wrong, correct it only through the official Glider flow. If it is correct, continue.

fixes.title: Reopen the stage once
fixes.action: After the displayed waiting window or a completed action, reopen Glider once and check whether the stage advanced.
fixes.expected: A completed verification or claim should move to the next stage.
fixes.next: If it remains past the displayed window, is rejected despite a qualifying portfolio, or claim/unstake fails, open Discord support with the portfolio URL, shown balance, stage, submission time, and exact error.

splitInfo.note: Each Glider stage has distinct requirements and waiting periods
